chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Khālid, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a boil that appears on a man and then bursts while he is in salat (prayer). He said: “He should wipe it, and wipe his hand on the wall or on the ground, and he should not cut short the salat (prayer).”

key_terms.الدُّمَّلِ: a boil or swelling on the body
key_terms.وَلَا يَقْطَعُ: and he does not break or interrupt

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if a boil bursts during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person in salat (prayer) whose boil bursts during the prayer. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that he should wipe it and wipe his hand on the wall or ground, and he should continue the salat (prayer) without breaking it.
